AYNI

Official release channel for AYNI, the offline AI support app for children with autism spectrum disorder. A project of WIE UTP and IEEE EPICS.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://wie-utp.github.io/ayni-releases/repo
